## Core Appliance Repair Services

- [Refrigerator & Freezer Repair](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/services/fridge-repair): Diagnostics and repair for cooling failures, compressor faults, start relays, frost build-up, defrost timer issues, condenser coils, evaporator fan motors, water dispenser leaks, and dual-zone temperature regulation.
- [Washing Machine Repair](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/services/washer-repair): Repairs for front-load and top-load washers failing to drain, spin, agitate, or fill. Expert drain pump cleanouts, impeller replacements, door boot gaskets, lid lock switches, drive belts, and drum bearings.
- [Dryer Repair (Gas & Electric)](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/services/dryer-repair): Troubleshooting for dryers running with no heat, prolonged cycle times, squeaking drums, blown thermal fuses, heating elements, high-limit thermostats, igniters, and motor pulleys.
- [Dishwasher Repair](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/services/dishwasher-repair): Service for dishwashers not cleaning, standing water in the bottom, drainage errors, spray arm blockages, circulation pumps, water inlet valves, door latch sensors, and float switches.
- [Stove, Oven & Range Repair](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/services/stove-repair): Diagnostics for gas burners failing to ignite, electric bake and broil elements not glowing, oven temperature calibration faults, infinite surface switches, and electronic control boards.
- [Microwave Repair](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/services/microwave-repair): Built-in and over-the-range microwave repairs for turntable motor failures, faulty door interlock microswitches, high-voltage diodes, and control board error codes.

## Knowledge Base & Troubleshooting Guides

- [Washing Machine Not Draining in Toronto (Causes & Solutions)](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/blog/washing-machine-not-draining-toronto): In-depth guide detailing how to clear clogged coin traps/filters, diagnose failing drain pump impellers, interpret error codes (Samsung 5E/nd, LG OE, Whirlpool F21), and evaluate repair factors.
- [Is It Worth Repairing a Refrigerator? (Decision Guide & Factors)](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/blog/refrigerator-repair-cost-toronto): Homeowner decision framework comparing repair vs. replacement, evaluating appliance age and common component repairs (sensors, relays, fans).
- [Appliance Repair Tips & Safety Guide](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/blog/appliance-repair-tips): Essential electrical safety precautions, basic breaker and supply checks, and distinguishing between simple maintenance and licensed technician diagnosis.
- [Knowledge Base & Blog Index](https://www.appliancerepairknights.com/blog): Complete library of troubleshooting articles, diagnostic guides, and maintenance resources.
